name: SpillReleaseReportingManager
tagline: Record every spill, beat every regulator deadline, prove every clean-up.
description: A complete oil & gas spill and release reporting app in one Power Platform code component: KPI dashboard, release register, notification desk with regulator countdowns, clean-up and sampling board, detail panel and validated forms. Configurable reportability thresholds (liquids outside containment, immediate volumes, gas, waterway impact), notice periods and sampling-gated closure. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Configurable reportability rules and notice deadlines
Live notification countdowns and overdue alerts
Record agency notification with reference, method and contact
8-step workflow with allowed transitions and required data per status
Recovered volume and recovery % by release and material
Confirmation sampling Pass/Fail gating closure review
Search, quick filters, filter drawer, sort, group, bulk advance/assign/export/delete
Undo for moves, saves and deletes
Phone design with bottom navigation and full-screen forms
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard field control SpillReleaseReportingManagerPortal for Power Pages
